title: fix(assist): preserve summary bodies under mixed-case headings
body:
## Problem

The plan-summary parser recognizes section headings without regard to case, but retrieves their bodies with a case-sensitive comparison. An otherwise usable completion headed `## summary`, `## CHANGES`, or `## TeStInG` can therefore lose its summary and test evidence and be replaced by placeholder text.

## Approach

Use the same case-insensitive matching when finding each recognized section body. Keep the exact-heading ordered fast path, so already canonical output remains unchanged and noncanonical headings are normalized.

## Changes

- Preserve section bodies through one case-insensitive lookup.
- Cover mixed case, reordered sections with one missing section, and the existing first-recognized-section behavior when a heading repeats.
- Clarify heading matching in the assist spec.

### Validation

Native Bun 1.4.4 with the server's isolated-home preload: **6 passed / 3 failed** before the fix; **9 passed / 0 failed** after it (33 assertions). Full repository lint passes (2,524 files), server typecheck passes, the public-spec check passes, and `git diff --check` passes.

**Required full gates remain incomplete; this is a prepared proposal.** The same base's full typecheck is blocked by the paired Hutch download (DNS `EAI_AGAIN`), and Chromium installation fails with an invalid downloaded archive. Full unit testing with the separate speech fix finished with 24/26 tasks successful; two package-directory failures were independently reproduced on the clean base in this workspace, and one full-suite watcher-latency failure remains unresolved. Those results are not presented as a passing full-suite run for this branch.

## Screenshots

Not applicable — no frontend changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Fast gates pass: `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test`
- [ ] E2E suite passes for app-affecting changes (`bun run e2e`, or `bun run e2e:full` when touching agent behavior)
- [x] Before/after screenshots are included for frontend changes, or marked not applicable
- [x] Relevant `SPEC.md` / top-level specs updated to reflect any boundary, contract, or behavior change
- [x] I have read the [Contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
